timezoneRule.delayRule: A task is delayed only when status is not done and due_date is earlier than the current Asia/Seoul date.
timezoneRule.dailyRecordRule: daily_records.record_date is assigned by the server using the current Asia/Seoul date; one row per user/date is kept by upsert.

app_users.security: password_hash stores bcrypt output only; password plaintext is never stored

app_sessions.security: token_hash stores SHA-256 of the random session token; token plaintext is never stored in DB

relations: source_review_id -> reviews.id ON DELETE SET NULL

tasks.softDelete: deleted_at is set instead of physically deleting task history

task_status_events.idempotencyRule: No event is inserted when the requested status equals the current status.

execution_logs.noteRule: note is an optional free-form work memo; blocker_reason is optional and used only when execution was blocked.

aggregationRules.task_count: count of tasks where deleted_at is null
aggregationRules.completed_count: count of active tasks where status = done
aggregationRules.delayed_count: count of active tasks where status != done and due_date < current Asia/Seoul date
aggregationRules.blocked_count: count of distinct active tasks that have at least one non-empty blocker_reason
aggregationRules.estimated_minutes: sum of estimated_minutes of active tasks, or 0
aggregationRules.actual_minutes: sum of execution_logs.actual_minutes for active tasks, or 0

daily_records.rule: Exactly five distinct real Asia/Seoul dates are required. The fixed metric is actual work time in minutes. Missing work logs count as 0, duplicate same-day daily records are updated in place, stored values are not clipped as outliers, execution duration is rounded to whole minutes, and the week starts on Monday.

rule_changes.rule: Insert is allowed only when exactly two daily_records exist. The row stores explicit references to the first and second daily records, so the change is auditable as occurring after day 2 and before day 3.
